fb6c214e.text:
We will attack the city of Brill just before dawn. The ancillary force will set the zeppelin tower aflame as a distraction. Once the fire is lit and the city defenders are drawn away, the main force led by the lieutenant will engage from the north. The Magistrate and civilians are the primary targets. Destroy all you see, and incinerate the bodies.

They say that the Forsaken feel no fear. We will put the fear of the light back into them, brothers and sisters. For Lordaeron!
fb6c214e.title: Scarlet Crusade Attack Plans

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10781|cb1093ae.name: Royal Overseer Bauhaus
10781|cb1093ae.text: I am an officer of the city, working in the capacity of the Undercity's census.  Since our liberation from the Scourge, we have tried to keep an accurate track of our city's populace.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.  If you have business with me accordingly, please proceed.  You should know if you do, at any rate.

11046|6253ba70.name: Whuut
11046|6253ba70.text: All the bottles on this table are potions I brewed today. And they say a watched pot never boils. Ha!

15309|d11310f6.name: Spoops
15309|d11310f6.text: I'm sad!  It's Hallow's End, and I'm sick.  I'm going to miss out on trick-or-treating because I can't go out!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

257655|9f0fb116.name: Deathguard Billmuth
257655|9f0fb116.text: <Deathguard Billmuth absentmindedly fidgets as he looks around nervously. He is clearly very uncomfortable being here.>

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

3062|1605f087.name: Meela Dawnstrider
3062|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5624|f669426b.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|f669426b.text: Us know her good.  She Mary Edras at inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

8659|b2489254.name: Jes'rimon
8659|b2489254.text:
I give you warm greetin's, $c, as does the Shattered Hand.

Do not look so surprised, $N. There be shadows even on the highest perches of Orgrimmar--somethin' must hide there. The Shattered Hand take that role willingly. Thrall, even in his good heart, acknowledge that the Hand be necessary to ensure orc and troll safety.

But you not here to talk 'bout my business, you here for somethin' else.

9566|fc033aae.name: Zapetta
9566|fc033aae.text: My brother said we could make great money with this trade route, but he didn't tell me I would be the one living on this side. If you come back this way on the Zeppelin, could you bring me something to eat? They sell some of the finest meat in Orgrimmar, and I sure could use something that didn't die weeks before it stopped moving.

3093-progress.name: Meela Dawnstrider
3093-progress.text: As quickly as water falls from the sky, here you are before me. I am pleased by your haste. It means you realize both the importance of our meeting and you being here. I am no leader, but I do understand the elements, and I can speak to the spirits of our people. I will teach you to do the same.
3093-progress.title: Rune-Inscribed Note

366-progress.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-progress.text: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
366-progress.title: Return the Book

410-progress.name: Unknown
410-progress.text: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
410-progress.title: The Dormant Shade

411-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-progress.text: Have you returned Gunther's book?  Has he responded?
411-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

94436-accept.name: Danitha Morr
94436-accept.text:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true $c can do.
94436-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438-complete.name: Deathguard Falgan
94438-complete.text:
I'm... back? And saved by a $c no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.

If you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more that you can do to help the Forsaken.
94438-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440-accept.name: Deathguard Falgan
94440-accept.text:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive $c. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441-accept.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94441-accept.text:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Bandarion Keep performed for us. 

You have a lot of promise as a $c, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, $N.
94441-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441-complete.name: Danitha Morr
94441-complete.text:
The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by a $c who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely.

You have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the paladins of Bandarion Keep. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, $N.
94441-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

99156-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol
